## Module

Module ID and name (e.g., `401-crm-contacts`):

## Artifact

Which file contains the bug (e.g., `spec.md`, `api-contracts.md`):

## Description

Clear description of the error or inconsistency.

## Expected

What the spec should say.

## Actual

What the spec currently says.

## Impact

Which other modules or contracts are affected.
